rule60.text: The list holds what the records show once they are final (backend issue #60): a death once it is certified (never a draft, whose facts may still change, nor one brought dead), a readmission once the earlier stay was discharged, a return to theatre once both operations have their times; all within incident_screening_days. Say so on the empty list, so nobody waits for a death still being written.

rule57.text: A complaint another desk received (decision 63): 'Track a complaint' asks for the tracking number and calls GET /complaints/by-number/{complaint_number} (exact; NOT_FOUND: no such number). The card says how it stands, never what it says: confirm complainant_name with the person at the desk, then give the status, the contact person and answer_due, or the last day to appeal (appeal_until). 'Record appeal' while can_appeal; afterwards this desk opens the complaint (can_open).
